lessons_learned: Physical A4 height (296mm) in browser print engines equates to exactly 1118.6px at 96 DPI. To prevent accidental page spills in PDF generation, table rows must be partitioned across sheets with explicit capacity limits (e.g. 4 rows on opening sheet with institutional header, 6 rows on continuation sheets, and 1-2 rows on final sign-off sheet with signatories).

In print stylesheets, interactive textarea elements render browser UI scrollbar thumb dots even when scroll is inactive. Using dual DOM presentation (textarea with print:hidden + static pre-wrap div with hidden print:block text-[8.5pt] leading-tight) completely eliminates blue scrollbars and produces razor-sharp typography.

Container CSS isolation: Browser print parses the whole DOM tree. Sibling cards and parent navigation components must be suppressed using both explicit 'no-print' utility classes and scoped CSS selectors (e.g. .card:not(:has(.adm-sheet-paper-container)) { display: none !important; }).
